verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support subagents spawned by a main agent to isolate context and run parallel focused analyses, with session forking to branch off work, plus hooks and permission controls to govern subagent tool use — covering the core of multi-agent orchestration within one workflow. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of complex multi-agent handoff patterns, no explicit named 'crew' style orchestration framework, and community evidence focuses on harness/UX complaints rather than confirming multi-agent orchestration quality.
